subject: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan

Thanks for the time today, James — quick recap and a minimal POC proposal so we have a clear next step. I captured the items we discussed and a proposed 3-week pilot cadence that should show measurable wins without exposing sensitive production traffic.

Key pain points you confirmed
- Rising per-request cost due to growing prompt length and token churn (esp. in multi-turn workflows).
- 95th/99th percentile tail latency spikes impacting interactive review workflows.
- Model drift: predictions degrade on recently onboarded vendors and rare categories.
- Compliance: sensitive PII in transcripts; ClearWave needs strict retention & auditability.

Top-level POC goals (success metrics)
- Reduce per-1k-token cost by >= 25% (target: 30%) from baseline.
- 95th percentile latency for 512-token requests < 300ms.
- Maintain or improve labeled accuracy on holdout set (+/-1% of current baseline).

Proposed minimum viable POC (3 weeks) — scope & owners
- Week 0 (prep): provide pseudonymized sample (approx 10k rows), grant Redwood a read-only S3 bucket or SFTP drop, security checklist & account for test tenancy. Owners: James (ClearWave prod lead), Marissa (Redwood SA).
- Week 1: baseline run on your chosen model (unmodified) to capture latency/cost/quality. Owner: Ben/Logan.
- Week 2: run 2 optimized variants (mixed-precision/4-bit quant + KV prefix caching) and a prompt-eval on a 200-example suite we build together. Owner: Marissa.
- Week 3: final comparison, handoff artifacts (playbook, runbook), and recommendations for Dedicated vs Private deployment. Owner: Logan.

Access & setup steps we need
1) Service account with read-only access to the POC S3 path or temporary SFTP creds.
2) A contact for infra (IP allowlist / VPC peering) — we noted Maya Singh as infra lead; please confirm.
3) Pseudonymized sample (PII replaced with consistent tokens) + schema doc.
4) Compliance questionnaire answers (SOC2, encryption at rest key hints).

Attachments: clearwave_poc_charter.pdf (2 pages), access_matrix.csv (template), poa-scope.xlsx (scope + success metric template)

Next steps
- If this plan looks good, we’ll send a short MSA addendum + scoped SOW and schedule a 30-minute kickoff to align infra and data access.
- Proposed kickoff window: week of May 18–25.

Appreciate the frank discussion today — I’ll hold off on any data pulls until we confirm access pattern.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
log an@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: James Park <james@clearwave.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan

Thanks, Logan — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: we cannot share raw PII outside the VPC for the initial evaluation (legal prefers pseudonymized extracts only). Also, our infra team needs to know whether Redwood needs outgoing connections or if we can host the runtime on a private peering path.

On metrics: the 95th <300ms target is aggressive but valuable — we mainly care about the interactive reviewer path. For cost, the baseline is ~ $0.45 per 1k tokens on our current provider; improving that is attractive.

Maya Singh (maya.singh@clearwave.ai) is our infra lead — copying her on future infra asks. Suggested kickoff: May 24 or the week after if you need more prep.

Also, can you confirm retention/audit log capabilities for the Private deployment (we’ll need 1-year retention and exportable logs for audits)?

—James
CTO | ClearWave Analytics
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan

Appreciate the quick follow-up, James — answers inline and a few mitigations: 

- PII & data residency: we can run the POC in Redwood Private (VPC peering or transit) so no customer data leaves your environment. For rapid iteration, we accept pseudonymized extracts via S3/SFTP for the first week, but we will only start any material testing in your VPC if you prefer.
- Outbound connections: optional — our runtime can be deployed in your VPC with no egress; only the control-plane needs connectivity for metrics (can be routed through your bastion).
- Retention & audit logs: Redwood Private supports configurable retention windows (including 1 year) and exportable audit logs (syslog/S3). I’ll attach the SOC2 excerpt and a compliance Q&A.

I’ve attached the minimal POC charter (clearwave_poc_charter.pdf) and an access matrix template. I’ll open a short HubSpot deal note with the proposed timeline and link it to your account.

If May 24 works, we’ll lock it in and send a 30-min kickoff agenda focused on infra & data access only. If you’d prefer a pre-kickoff call with Maya and our SRE, we can do 20 minutes the week prior.

Regards,
Logan
[Attachment: clearwave_poc_charter.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james@clearwave.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan

Quick ops note from the SA side so infra has a concrete checklist before kickoff: 

1) IP allowlist: if you host the runtime in your VPC, provide a CIDR for our control-plane access and a separate set for SRE/diagnostics.
2) Service account: we need a short-lived read-only role for the pseudonymized S3 bucket and a dedicated object prefix.
3) Secrets & keys: if you use a KMS, provide a key ARN with decrypt-only for the POC service account; otherwise we recommend short-lived signed URLs.
4) Observability hooks: give us a CloudWatch/Syslog endpoint or S3 prefix for logs (we will not ship logs out unless explicitly enabled).

Owners (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole: SA & prompt-eval owner (prompt suite + eval harness).
- Logan Wright: program lead & decision owner for model/config rollouts.
- Ben Carter: commercial owner & SOW coordination.

Suggested internal milestones
- By May 17: infra contact confirmed + access_matrix.csv returned.
- By May 20: pseudonymized sample uploaded (min 5k rows).
- May 24 kickoff: 30-min infra alignment; full POC work begins May 25.

I’ll attach a runbook snippet and an example access_matrix.csv template (attached).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access_matrix.csv]
From: James Park <james@clearwave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: ClearWave discovery — technical debt & minimum-viable POC plan

Sounds good. Confirming Maya Singh (maya.singh@clearwave.ai) is our infra contact — she’ll coordinate the IP allowlist and temporary service account. We’ll aim to have the access_matrix.csv back to you by the 17th and upload a pseudonymized sample by the 20th.

May 24 kickoff works — tentatively booked on our side for 10:00 AM PT. If you can send a 30-minute agenda (infra + data + success metrics) we’ll accept.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing measurable wins on latency and cost.

Best,
James
CTO | ClearWave Analytics
